body:
## Context

Binding design: docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md ("Capture", "Continue", "Supervised-only auto-consume", contract item 24). Prerequisites shipped: capture store + `adlc handoff continue` in @adlc/context-handoff. This slice delivers the Claude Code experience: a supervisor wrapper giving true zero-touch handoff->restart, plus a keyless near-auto fallback for unsupervised sessions. Decisions locked 2026-08-13: wrapper is the blessed full-auto path; consume is supervised-only (hooks NEVER consume — they are deliberately key-scrubbed, see plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs secret-scrub, and that posture must not change here).

Live-probe facts (2026-08-13, claude v2.1.231) this design relies on:
- `claude --session-id <minted-uuid> "<prompt>"` works BOTH headless (-p) and interactive: TUI boots, auto-submits the prompt, honors the minted id, persists the transcript.
- Transcript path is predictable: `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<uuid>.jsonl` where encoded-cwd replaces '/' and '.' with '-'.
- CRITICAL: inherited child-session env markers disable transcript saving — the supervisor MUST scrub CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT from the child env (contract item 24).
- SessionStart context injection shape: `hookSpecificOutput: { hookEventName: 'SessionStart', additionalContext }` (already used at adlc-hook.mjs:338).

## Build

1. New lib/supervise.mjs in packages/context-handoff (bin glue stays thin — dependency-inject the spawner, clock, and continue-runner so the loop is unit-testable): `superviseLoop({ spawn, runContinue, now, ... })` implementing: mint uuid A -> spawn `claude --session-id A [passthrough args]` (env scrubbed per above, stdio inherit) -> poll `.adlc/handoffs/denies/A.json` (~2s interval; fs.watch not trusted) -> on open deny: wait for quiescence (transcript mtime stable >= 5s OR child exited) -> runContinue({ denySession: A, captureFrom: transcriptPath(A) }) -> on success: SIGTERM child (SIGKILL after 10s grace), print continuation banner, respawn `claude --session-id <successor> "<bootstrap_prompt>"`, loop with A = successor. On continue degrade (exit 2): leave the child running, print the operator one-liner, stop watching (single warning). SIGINT forwards to child; loop exits when child exits with no open deny for A.
2. bin/handoff.mjs: `supervise` subcommand: `adlc handoff supervise [--dir .adlc] -- claude [args...]` wiring real spawner (node:child_process), real continue runner (in-process call or child `adlc handoff continue --write`; key comes from the OPERATOR'S env and is passed only to the continue step, never into the claude child env).
3. Deny-message capture instruction: extend the handoff deny message (package adapter message used by the CC hook) to append: "Context handoff active: write your handoff summary (state, done, remaining, next steps, dead ends) as your final message, then stop." This is what makes the transcript extraction meaningful.
4. Near-auto SessionStart fallback (keyless, plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs SessionStart path): when the deny store has open denies: (a) if a resume-auth document exists for THIS session id (i.e., the wrapper pre-consumed for us), inject additionalContext = capture content + ticket pointer + "you are the continuation" directive; (b) else emit a systemMessage naming the newest open deny and the exact one-liner: `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY=... adlc handoff continue --deny-session <id> --write`. No key reads in hook code; no consume in hooks.
5. Tests: unit-test superviseLoop via DI stub spawner (deny appears -> continue invoked with captureFrom -> child terminated -> respawn argv carries --session-id <successor> and the bootstrap prompt; degrade -> no kill, single warning; env scrub asserted on every spawn call = contract item 24; quiescence gate honored). Hook tests for both SessionStart branches and for the deny-message instruction text. E2E stub: a fake `claude` executable fixture (records argv+env to a file, writes a minimal transcript JSONL, idles) driven by the real supervise subcommand in a temp repo fixture with a real deny marker + key — proves the full loop with no live API. Optional env-gated live check (ADLC_CC_LIVE=1) documented in the test file header, not run in CI.

## Constraints

- Rails freeze the spec mirrors and the package contract tests (continue-*.test.mjs / capture-*.test.mjs) — the wrapper must satisfy them, not adapt them.
- Hook code must remain key-scrubbed; adding any ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY/ADLC_ADMIN_KEY read to plugins/adlc-claude-code hook code is a defect (add a test asserting the scrub list still covers them before project-code import).
- plugins/adlc-claude-code hook files follow the existing wrapper/timeout conventions (adlc-hook-run.mjs timeoutExitCode=2 fail-closed posture — do not regress).

## Acceptance criteria

- Supervise loop unit tests + hook tests + e2e stub green. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/*.test.mjs` and `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` exit 0.
- Env scrub proven. verify: supervise unit test asserts child env lacks all four markers on every spawn.
- Near-auto keyless. verify: grep shows no manifest-key read in plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/ SessionStart path; scrub-order test passes.
- Zero-touch loop proven. verify: e2e stub test shows deny -> continue -> respawn with successor id + bootstrap prompt, and denier marker consumed exactly once.

## Rails note

This ticket stays rails-less: rails-guard-ci's isCompletionAnnotationOnly only lets an ordinary PR complete a ticket with NO rails at base, so declaring rails would make this ticket uncompletable until the completion-ceremony gate (T-01M008KXY2DNBMTBQSYMXP63GB) ships. The freeze intent (spec + S2 contract tests untouched) is enforced by review and by the acceptance checks below instead.

## S2 handover facts (verified against the shipped package)

- The continue payload arrives wrapped in the standard CLI envelope ({ tool, command, dryRun, evidence, ... }) with the five spec keys inside — parse accordingly.
- Capture-tamper detection does NOT live in resume-auth (the HMAC covers the auth document's fields, not file bytes). The package exports verifyCaptureHash which re-derives the hash from disk; the supervisor MUST call it and refuse to inject on mismatch (treat as degrade: leave child, print operator one-liner).
- plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/handoff-gate.mjs carries its own isProtectedHandoffPath copy that still LACKS the .adlc/handoffs/content/** rule — add the rule there AND add a content-path case to adapter-test/cc-helper-drift.test.mjs (its fixed case list currently makes this drift invisible).
- New lib modules available: capture.mjs (writeCapture/readCapture/hashCaptureBody/verifyCaptureHash), brief.mjs (composeBrief), transcript-extract.mjs (extractFinalAssistantMessage), checkpoint.mjs (shared write/rebind helper), continue-inputs.mjs (ticket pointer + evidence tail + git status gathering), text-cap.mjs. An unbound deny is never bound by continue — ticket resolution is a cross-check against the marker's bind, failing closed on disagreement.
title: Claude Code continuation: `adlc handoff supervise` wrapper + keyless near-auto SessionStart fallback
